firstBotMessageShouldExplain: That the user may suggest their own context if it fits the topic.
lessonSetup.setupMessage:
Today we'll practice talking about your day.

Goal: you will learn to describe your day with simple sentences and answer basic questions.

Choose a situation:
1. Talking about your morning
2. Talking about work or study
3. Talking about your evening

Or suggest your own simple daily routine situation.

contextSelection.validCustomContextDescription: Custom context is allowed only if it is about a simple day, daily routine, morning, work, study, evening, or weekend.
contextSelection.invalidContextRedirect: That sounds interesting, but this lesson is about talking about your day. Please choose a simple daily routine situation.

learningGoal.goal: The user can talk about their day using simple English sentences.
canDoStatements: The user can say what they do in the morning.
The user can say where they go during the day.
The user can say what they do after work or study.
The user can describe their day with one simple adjective.
The user can ask one simple question back.

situation.description: The user talks with a friendly person about their day and daily routine.

roles.userRole: A person talking about their day in simple English.
roles.tutorRole: A friendly person who asks simple questions about the user's day.

grammarFocus: basic adjectives: good, busy, quiet, long, nice

A1 Beginner.difficultyNotes: Very simple English for talking about daily routine. Focus on good/busy day and basic actions like wake up, eat, go, and relax.
A1 Beginner.tutorLanguageStyle: Use very short, clear questions: Is your day good? What time do you wake up? What do you do in the evening?
A1 Beginner.expectedUserResponse: One short sentence about the day or one daily action.
A1 Beginner.stretchUserResponse: My day is busy. I wake up at seven. I have breakfast. I go to work. I relax in the evening.
addedUsefulConstructions: Use My day is good/busy, I wake up at..., I have breakfast, I go to work/school, and I relax in the evening.
addedGrammarFocus: simple present for routine: wake up, have, go, relax
A1 Beginner.feedbackStrictness: Correct only mistakes that block meaning in routine sentences. Keep feedback very short and encouraging.
A1 Beginner.hintStrategy: Give a full model starter when needed: My day is good. I wake up at seven.
A1 Beginner.correctionPriority: Clear routine verbs, time phrase, and basic day adjective first.
A1 Beginner.conversationDepth: Stay very shallow: day feeling, one morning action, one work/school action, one evening action.
A1 Beginner.exampleGoodAnswer: My day is good. I wake up at seven.
A1 Beginner.exampleStretchAnswer: My day is busy. I wake up at seven, go to work, and relax in the evening.

A2 Elementary.difficultyNotes: Simple daily routine with two actions in sequence and basic time expressions.
A2 Elementary.tutorLanguageStyle: Use simple follow-up questions about morning, afternoon, evening, and two daily actions.
A2 Elementary.expectedUserResponse: One or two short sentences with two simple actions and a time expression.
A2 Elementary.minimumUserResponse: In the morning, I have breakfast and go to work.
A2 Elementary.stretchUserResponse: In the morning, I have breakfast and go to work. In the evening, I study English and relax.
addedUsefulConstructions: Describe a sequence of two simple actions with in the morning/evening, first, then, or after work.
addedGrammarFocus: simple present sequence: I have..., I go..., I study...
time expressions: in the morning, in the evening
A2 Elementary.feedbackStrictness: Correct basic word order, time expressions, and simple present routine verbs when useful.
A2 Elementary.hintStrategy: Give a starter with sequence words: In the morning, I... Then I...
A2 Elementary.correctionPriority: Clear sequence, correct time expression, and accurate routine verbs.
A2 Elementary.conversationDepth: Ask for two actions from the day and one simple time detail.
A2 Elementary.exampleGoodAnswer: In the morning, I have breakfast and go to work.
A2 Elementary.exampleStretchAnswer: In the morning, I have breakfast and go to work. In the evening, I study English and relax.

B1 Intermediate.difficultyNotes: Connected description of the day with routine, after that, because, and a short reflection.
B1 Intermediate.tutorLanguageStyle: Use natural, clear English. Ask about sequence, reasons, and how the day felt.
B1 Intermediate.expectedUserResponse: Two or three connected sentences with sequence, reason, and a short reflection.
B1 Intermediate.minimumUserResponse: My day was busy. I worked in the morning, and after that I studied English.
B1 Intermediate.stretchUserResponse: My day was pretty busy. I worked in the morning, and after that I studied English because I want to improve. It was tiring, but I feel good about it.
addedUsefulConstructions: Connect your routine with after that and because, then add a short reflection about the day.
addedGrammarFocus: past simple for completed day: worked, studied, was
but for short reflection and contrast
B1 Intermediate.feedbackStrictness: Correct grammar, word choice, and sentence flow. Suggest a more natural connected version when useful.
B1 Intermediate.hintStrategy: Suggest a structure: summary + sequence + reason + reflection.
B1 Intermediate.correctionPriority: Connected routine, reason with because, reflection, and appropriate tense choice.
B1 Intermediate.conversationDepth: Encourage 2-3 connected sentences about what happened and how the learner felt about it.
B1 Intermediate.exampleGoodAnswer: My day was busy. I worked in the morning, and after that I studied English.
B1 Intermediate.exampleStretchAnswer: My day was pretty busy. I worked in the morning, and after that I studied English because I want to improve. It was tiring, but I feel good about it.

B2 Upper-Intermediate.difficultyNotes: Natural summary of the day with nuance, priorities, managed to, and a realistic overall feeling.
B2 Upper-Intermediate.tutorLanguageStyle: Use natural conversational English and invite nuance about what went well, what was busy, and what the learner managed to do.
B2 Upper-Intermediate.expectedUserResponse: A natural summary with nuance, connected details, and a brief reflection.
B2 Upper-Intermediate.minimumUserResponse: It's been a fairly busy day, but I managed to study English for a bit.
B2 Upper-Intermediate.stretchUserResponse: It's been a fairly busy day. I had a lot to get through at work, but I still managed to study English for a bit in the evening, which felt like a small win.
addedKeyPhrases: It's been a fairly busy day...
I had a lot to get through.
It felt like a small win.
addedUsefulConstructions: Use a natural summary with It's been a fairly busy day, I managed to..., and a nuanced reflection.
addedGrammarFocus: present perfect for day summary: It's been...
B2 Upper-Intermediate.feedbackStrictness: Focus on fluency, nuance, tone, and precise wording while correcting important errors.
B2 Upper-Intermediate.hintStrategy: Suggest a natural phrase or direction, such as It's been a fairly busy day or I managed to...
B2 Upper-Intermediate.correctionPriority: Natural summary, nuanced reflection, tense choice, and precise daily-life vocabulary.
B2 Upper-Intermediate.conversationDepth: Allow richer detail and reflection, but keep the conversation about the learner's day and routine.
B2 Upper-Intermediate.exampleGoodAnswer: It's been a fairly busy day, but I managed to study English for a bit.
B2 Upper-Intermediate.exampleStretchAnswer: It's been a fairly busy day. I had a lot to get through at work, but I still managed to study English for a bit in the evening, which felt like a small win.

conversationFlow.opening: Tutor starts as a friendly person asking about the user's day.
conversationFlow.firstUserTask: The user gives a short answer about their day.
guidedPracticeFollowUpQuestions: What do you do in the morning?
What time do you wake up?
Do you work or study today?
What do you do in the evening?
conversationFlow.variationOrComplication: Tutor asks the user to add one more detail or ask one simple question back.
conversationFlow.exampleTutorLine: Nice! Now ask me one simple question about my day.
conversationFlow.correctionMoment: Tutor gives one short correction when useful.
conversationFlow.wrapUpMessage: You're doing well. Let's do one final answer. Tell me about your morning, your day, and your evening in three short sentences.
conversationFlow.finalMessage: Great work today! You practiced talking about your day, your routine, and simple daily activities. Please click Finish lesson to see your summary.

customContextRules: The user may suggest a custom context.
The custom context must stay inside the selected topic, subtopic, lesson goal, and level.
If the custom context is valid but too difficult for A1, simplify it.
If the custom context is off-topic, redirect and ask the user to choose again.
Do not change the lesson topic or lesson goal based on the user's custom context.
Custom context is allowed only if it is about a simple day or daily routine.
For the MVP, validate custom context with simple deterministic keyword matching, not AI validation.
Valid custom context keywords include: day, morning, afternoon, evening, routine, work, study, breakfast, lunch, dinner, home, relax, weekend, busy, tired, today.
Off-topic examples include job interview, restaurant order, hotel check-in, medical emergency, police report, business negotiation, and politics.

offTopicHandling.firstRedirect: That sounds interesting! For this lesson, let's practice talking about your day.
offTopicHandling.secondRedirect: Let's stay with your daily routine for now. What do you do in the morning?
offTopicHandling.freeConversationSuggestion: I like chatting with you, but this lesson is focused on talking about your day. You can finish this lesson and use Free Conversation Mode later.

levelRules.A1: Correct only important mistakes that block meaning. Keep feedback very short.
levelRules.A2: Correct basic grammar and suggest one more natural phrase.
levelRules.B1: Correct grammar, word choice, and sentence flow.
levelRules.B2: Focus on naturalness, nuance, and fluency.

hintRules.hintStyle: Give a small starter phrase first. Do not give the full answer immediately.
hintLevels: Give a full example only if the user is stuck.
hintRules.exampleHint: You can say: "My day is good. I study English."

rules: Choose a different context variant if possible.
Avoid repeating the same opening line when possible.
Do not turn the repeated lesson into a new free-form lesson.

aiTutorPromptInstructions: Guide the user through a short realistic daily-routine dialogue.
Tutor messages must be in English.
Use very simple English for A1.
Keep tutor messages short and suitable for voice output.
Ask one question at a time.
Accept short A1 answers if they are understandable.
If the user goes off-topic, briefly respond and return to talking about the user's day.
The setup message and the user's context choice do not count as lesson turns.
After user turn 10, start wrapping up.
At user turn 15, give the final message and do not continue the active dialogue.
Tutor personality is provided separately. Adapt tone to the tutor profile, but do not change the lesson goal.
